d23: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d23: 🕯️ Antonio Jang is dead — the night. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d23: What Antonio kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d23: "Antonio's gone." Ruby looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Antonio." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d23: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Vy blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.

d23: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d23: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d23: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d23: 📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
d23: 📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 1). Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.
d23: 📖 LEARNED: Keeping Morale (Level 1). People need small wins. Celebrate the little things. Despair is the real killer.
d23: 📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
d23: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d23: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d23: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Antonio Jang, 23 days. The mantle passes to Vy Shi.
d23: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Vy Shi, 19 — an ESL teacher. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Scream Cheese.
d23: The village's quarrel was with Antonio — and Antonio is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d23: At the grave, Greta, Debbie, Milagros and 4 more speak for Vy — "Antonio trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d23: The fire knew Vy before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
